headline: The sea wears each Age
lede: MYST's ocean was one blue plane everywhere. Now the island lands in dusk amber, Selenitic's water is the green of its haze, Stoneship's Atlantic heaves with the shelf's biggest swell, and Channelwood sits like moss-dark glass — with foam hugging every sculpted coast.

notes.text: #838 item 2 merged (PR #1586): a new pure sea.js pitches colour, swell and drift per view; foam lines exist exactly where the sculpted ground meets its own sea level — dry puzzle beds never wear a waterline.
mystcheck grew a sea section — hue laws per Age, swell ordering (ocean > chop > wash > glass), determinism, foam-on-coast-only — plus six new sea mutants; all 84 mutants die, 671 assertions green.
#838 stays open: next stage is the island's own shores (dock, beach, cliffs still sit on the shared dusk sea un-sculpted). QA polish pass filed as #1587 (ragged foam, swell sound, sun glints).
#1570 (robot kit 4a) stays held — slot b's draft PR #1583 waits on gate 6 (transit-lift creep); the next slot-a session resumes it once its claim lock lapses.

look.text: Sail the teal Atlantic: link Stoneship and watch the quarterdeck heave
